body.objective: Put the certified tagged-spectator and connected six-point tree amplitudes on one normalized finite-volume spectator mode, derive the exact missing identity-overlap factor in their order-lambda6 interference, and classify the fixed-time thermodynamic and secular finite-volume limits.
activates: a dimensionless finite-volume tagged tree-cross probability contribution
the exact resolution/volume scaling of the resonant lambda6 term
a decision whether the resonance survives the fixed-time thermodynamic limit
body.current_gate: Use the public cross-CCR and delta normalization to prove that a positive ghost-even spectator box mode has norm N_s=2*E_s*V, that normalization cancels N_s in the spectator tree but divides the connected tree by N_s, and propagate this factor through the certified external-jet interference and tagged leading probability.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate and independent verifier for the one-particle box normalization, the relative 1/N_s cross factor, the dimensionless tagged tree-cross coefficient at arbitrary scale kappa, its fixed-T V-to-infinity limit, its large-T behavior at fixed V, and the T/(kappa^2 V) double-scaling parameter, with strict boundaries excluding the complete lambda6 probability, loop/source/survival completion, Eq. 19, gravity and Lorentzian claims.
body.forbid: no finite-volume tree-cross contribution called the complete NLO probability; no vanishing fixed-time thermodynamic limit called all-time decoupling; no double-scaling parameter called a universal scattering rate; no reduced scalar result called Eq. 19, gravity, BV/BRST or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics; no literature-priority claim
body.resource_hint: With delta_3(0)=V=Lx*Ly*Lz and spectator energy E_s=6*kappa/5, the public cross-CCR gives N_s=2*E_s*V=12*kappa*V/5. Normalizing both external spectator legs cancels N_s in the disconnected identity amplitude and leaves 1/N_s multiplying the connected amplitude. Hence q_cross/q_tag^(4)=2*sqrt(2)*lambda^2*W_kappa(T)/(3*N_s), where W_kappa(T)=kappa^-2*w(kappa*T). At the fixture q_cross=125*sqrt(2)*lambda^6*W_kappa(T)*DeltaOmega/(12288*pi^2*kappa^3*Area*V). It vanishes as V^-1 at fixed T, grows as T/V at fixed V, and q_cross/q_tag tends (10*sqrt(2)/3)*lambda^2*T/(kappa^2*V) for large T.
